ArtisanProfile.title: ArtisanProfile
ArtisanProfile.description: Represents the profile of an artisan on the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Artisan Profile, typically the same as the userId.

name.description: The full name of the artisan.

craft.description: The artisan's primary craft (e.g., pottery, weaving).

region.description: The region the artisan is based in.

story.description: A narrative about the artisan's background and craft.

imageId.description: Reference to an image in the placeholder images file.

giTagDetails.description: Details related to the Government of India's GI tag verification, if applicable.

sellerAuthenticityBadge.description: Indicates if the artisan has been awarded the Seller Authenticity Badge.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product listed by an artisan.

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for the product, same as ID.

images.description: Array of image URLs for the product.

imageId.description: Reference to an image in the placeholder images file.

craft.description: The craft category of the product.

region.description: The region the product originates from.

CustomOrderRequest.title: CustomOrderRequest
CustomOrderRequest.description: Represents a custom order request from a buyer to an artisan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Custom Order Request.

description.description: Description of the custom order request.

requirements.description: Specific requirements for the custom order.

status.description: Status of the custom order request (e.g., pending, accepted, rejected, completed).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a message exchanged between a buyer and a seller.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Chat Message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the message was sent.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the marketplace (either buyer or seller).

googleId.description: Google ID of the user, if they signed up with Google.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Accessible only by the user themselves and admins. User Id is the firebase Auth UID

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user (Firebase Auth UID).

params.name: artisanId

definition.description: Stores all products listed by artisans. This is a root collection for easier querying of all products.

params.name: productId
params.description: The unique identifier for the product.

definition.description: Stores custom order requests from buyers to artisans. Includes the buyer's ID, artisan's ID, description, requirements, and status of the request.

params.name: customOrderRequestId
params.description: The unique identifier for the custom order request.

definition.description: Stores chat messages between buyers and sellers. Each message includes the sender's ID, receiver's ID, message content, timestamp, and translated message (if applicable).  The chat document should include denormalized `buyerId` and `sellerId` to avoid subcollection group queries.

params.description: The unique identifier for the chat.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the chat message.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Cultural Artisans Marketplace App. The key change is moving Products to a root collection `/products/{productId}` instead of a subcollection under artisans. This significantly simplifies querying for all products across all artisans, which is a primary access pattern for the marketplace (e.g., on the homepage and the main products page). While this denormalizes the artisan-product relationship slightly (each product document must still contain an `artisanId`), the performance and query flexibility gains are substantial. Security rules will ensure that only the correct artisan can create, update, or delete their own products by checking the `artisanId` field within the product document against their authenticated UID.
